rules.title: Express receiver location codes (RC/R1/R2)
rules.description: Express and Special Services labels must print the receiver location codes with the routing barcode (Arial Bold 22pt): RC = 'AU', R1 = blank and R2 = Nearest Depot from the Location Master File. The printed codes are cross-checked one way against the decoded routing barcode depot; Location Master File validity cannot be verified digitally.
